supplementaryTracking.method: KLT feature tracks, fixed face/LED exclusions, independent background, 10 fps at 854x480
supplementaryTracking.limitations: Separate tracks were estimated independently and may include drift, generated texture, occlusion or lighting. Displacement magnitude is not a matched trajectory or a motion-retention score.

observation: Engine completed a two-second core with context padding. Face/LED-excluded tracking found motion in both object regions, alongside greater background movement in the output. These measurements do not establish whether the source action was retained, nor does a contact sheet establish identity stability, complete facial visibility or lip sync. No human adoption is inferred.
